Thank you very much for your kind feedback. I really appreciate you for pointing out an unexpected bug. The issue with copying the Drep ID has been fixed and deployed, so please check it. As for the additional feature requested by another reviewer—such as viewing which votes each DRep has made—we’ll record it as community feedback and reflect it in the final milestone.

ms.promise:
The listed pages (O1–O5) are part of the planned scope for this milestone.
As this submission represents the pre-development milestone plan, no public URLs are available yet.
Actual live URLs will be provided upon completion and submission of the corresponding development milestone for fund release.
O1 – List of Cardano DApps
 A comprehensive, regularly updated directory of Cardano DApps, including project names, descriptions, categories (DeFi, NFT, Gaming, etc.), and verified official links
O2 – List of Cardano Influencers
 An organized list of global Cardano influencers by platform, content type, highlighting their contribution to ecosystem awareness
O3 – Wallet Portfolio Viewer
 Interactive viewer that displays wallet ADA & CNT balances using official Cardano APIs
O4 – Wallet Transaction History
 Search tool that retrieves and displays chronological transaction history for any given wallet address
O5 – Cardano Event Calendar
 An integrated calendar showcasing upcoming Cardano-related events (Catalyst, World Mobile, meetups etc) with date, title, and participation links
